map.同样现金流不折现时累计为 −5000、−2500、0、+2500，恰好 2 年回: With the same cash flows undiscounted, cumulative values are −5000, −2500, 0, +2500, so it pays back in exactly 2 years; after discounting about 2.35 years. The extra 0.35 years is the cost of tying up capital over that period, and the gap widens as the discount rate rises.
